msg: Hi there! Firstly, the gnomes will all appear in fixed pairs. These include Orange and brown, Pink and green, red and yellow and blue and purple. The positions of the gnomes may switch but the colours will always be paired together. Secondly, in these pairs, one will lead you to a bright forest, while the other will bring you to a autumn themed forest. Orange, green, blue and red will bring you to the bright forestBrown, pink, yellow and purple will bring you to the autumn forest.You will have to try to memorize which colour gnome brings you to the bright or autumn forest, and you will have to use that info to gain as many mushrooms as possible.Here is an example of this stategy: The green and pink gnomes appear, and you click the pink one. The pink one brings you to the autumn forest with a high amount of mushrooms, so you keep that in mind. The next time pink and green appear, you may choose green and see it has less mushrooms, so from that point on, you choose pink every time the two show up. (This is only an example! I do not know whether pink or green has a higher amount for sure, you will have to figure it out yourself!)I apologize if this doesn't make sense, or if it is too long. Have fun! :)(P.S, apart from the colour, the appearance of the gnomes do not have any impact! Don't worry about it, and just focus on the colour!)
